description: Deterministic PreToolUse gates backing 5 approved Major findings from docs/superpowers/reports/2026-07-13-skill-gap-triage.md: blocking install commands, direct GitHub CLI writes (including auto-merge and gh api field-flag implicit writes), warning (not blocking) on git push when the outward-artifact-preflight provenance scan flags a candidate, and Write calls that would overwrite an existing issue/PR/MR template. Also backs issue #413 (sub-issue of #357): blocking a new-issue-creation tool call whose body lacks an Acceptance Criteria Map or an explicit waiver. Also backs issue #517 (refs #285, #300): blocking a create/update_pull_request call carrying a PR body that, given a local diff touching skills/*/SKILL.md, lacks skill-audit disclosure evidence. Also backs issue #187 (via #525): blocking a create_pull_request call for a branch with no upstream configured, or with local commits not yet pushed to its upstream. Also backs issue #637: blocking mcp__github__merge_pull_request unconditionally, closing the gap where check-bash-safety.sh's shell-only 'gh pr merge' block had no equivalent coverage for the platform-integrated MCP tool call -- drafting-a-pr-to-merge/SKILL.md's own terminal action is converting a PR to DRAFT, never merging it. Also backs issue #657: blocking a create_pull_request call whose body cites no issue at all, or whose Closes/Fixes-cited issue(s) lack an Acceptance Criteria Map or a valid (non-'tracking') waiver, or are already closed -- closing the same asymmetry issue #413 closed at issue-creation time, now at PR-creation time. Fails closed (denies) when it cannot verify a cited issue's state at all (no GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN, or the GitHub API call fails after retries) -- this repository's first hook requiring a live network call.
